node.title: H3 double-accident nonzero-coupling ideal router
node.statement: For a fixed product lift, at most one quotient lift has zero characteristic-zero product-to-quotient coupling. Every positive cutoff-18 double accident therefore supplies at least R(t)-1 nonzero sparse coupling generators in the same degree-one row-prime ideal as a low-distance product star. One generator gives a finite three-generator candidate ideal; the full target-local batch preserves quotient excess. The zero locus is exactly the binary telescoping family and has 3(n-4)/2 unordered-product/ordered-quotient anchors.
